decisions.reason: As a supplement line closely related to the firm's OTC and pharmacy capabilities, it can still be supported with existing know-how, and the missing later website evidence is only a moderate warning sign.
This skin-and-hair supplement is related to the firm's knowledge base but is easy to substitute and, after no later visibility, appears too peripheral to justify continued resource commitment.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is related but scientifically and commercially more uncertain, and the lack of later visibility suggests the firm has learned it is too niche to keep funding.

Despite the earlier problem notice and weaker fit indicated in the prompt, the firm's strong regulatory, analytical, and manufacturing capabilities make remediation and continuation more likely than withdrawal.
The OTC migraine triptan still fits the firm's pharmacy-channel, quality, and development capabilities and is recent enough that management would typically allow more time to refine and scale it.
